title: K-flat cone presentations of distinguished module triangles
statement: Let A be a commutative ring in universe u, with a chosen derived category of ModuleCat A [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Every distinguished triangle T admits a chain map f:P1→P2 such that P1, P2 and mappingCone(f) are K-flat in the acyclic-tensor sense [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], and the derived image of the cone triangle is isomorphic to T as a triangle, including the connecting morphism. No boundedness or nonzero-ring hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: K-flat resolutions; parent diagram step 1, implemented using the proved functorial module resolution and Mathlib derived cone presentation.

proof.text: Use Mathlib DerivedCategory.mem_distTriang_iff to write T as the derived image of the cone of g:X→Y. Apply the source-library ModuleCat.hasFunctorialFlatResolution, its reduced LeftResolution.resolutionFunctor and resolutionNatTrans to g. The proved LeftResolution.kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj gives K-flat P1 and P2. These are applications of existing proved source-library declarations, not a new existence assumption.

Convert K-flatness to preservation of acyclic tensors using HomotopyCategory.kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic. For each acyclic V the tensor-cone isomorphism identifies V tensor cone(f) with cone(V tensor f). The latter cone is acyclic by the triangulated subcategory of acyclic complexes and acyclicity of its first two objects.

The derived images of the two resolution augmentations are isomorphisms. Naturality of resolutionNatTrans makes their first-arrow square commute. Apply Mathlib isoTriangleOfIso₁₂ to the two distinguished cone triangles and compose with the initial triangle isomorphism.

from.place: Tensor comparison proof: replace the distinguished triangle by a K-flat cone presentation, before the exact comparison diagram.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_kFlat_cone_triangle_presentation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)))
    (hT : T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles) :
    ∃ (P₁ P₂ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : P₁ ⟶ P₂),
      (∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V P₁ (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) ∧
      (∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V P₂ (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) ∧
      (∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V (CochainComplex.mappingCone f)
          (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.mapTriangle.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangle f) ≅
        T)
